message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-13 05:10 IST to 2026-11-14 05:10 IST (2026-11-12 23:40 UTC to 2026-11-13 23:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt only. Obvious aliases were normalized and duplicate product entries were merged. DLL_software_component.txt was not read or combined.

Three credible, newly published vulnerabilities survived the freshness, relevance, and deduplication checks. All three affect official MongoDB ecosystem components and were disclosed shortly after the start of this scan window. No other monitored-product finding met all inclusion criteria.

### CVE-2026-126982 - MongoDB C# Driver BSON deserialization allow-list bypass

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB C# Driver 3.2.0 through versions earlier than 3.14.0.
- **Severity:** High; CVSS v4.0 7.7 and CVSS v3.1 7.5.
- **Description:** A BSON deserialization type allow-list can be bypassed when an application deserializes polymorphic data into loosely typed members. If a suitable .NET gadget type is present, attacker-controlled BSON or JSON may lead to arbitrary code execution in the application process.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB is explicitly monitored, and the C# Driver is an official MongoDB driver within the mandatory ecosystem scope.
- **Freshness:** MongoDB's CNA record was published on 2026-11-13 at 00:00 UTC, inside the scan window.
- **Source:** [CVE Program record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-126982), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-126982)

### CVE-2026-126839 - MongoDB C# Driver anonymous-type deserialization bypass

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB C# Driver 2.21.0 through versions earlier than 3.14.0.
- **Severity:** Low under CVSS v4.0 (2.3); Medium under CVSS v3.1 (4.2).
- **Description:** An overly permissive check for compiler-generated anonymous types can let untrusted BSON construct types outside the intended allow-list, potentially causing unauthorized object state and downstream application errors.
- **Relevance:** This is a separate official MongoDB C# Driver flaw and is not a duplicate of CVE-2026-126982.
- **Freshness:** MongoDB's CNA record was published on 2026-11-12 at 23:58 UTC, inside the scan window.
- **Source:** [CVE Program record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-126839), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-126839)

### CVE-2026-126792 - MongoDB libmongocrypt heap overflow

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB libmongocrypt 1.1.0 through 1.21.2.
- **Severity:** Medium; CVSS v4.0 5.7 and CVSS v3.1 4.7.
- **Description:** The GCP KMS signing callback can copy an oversized RSA signature into a fixed-size heap buffer. Exploitation requires high-privilege control of the embedding application's in-process KMS provider configuration; the demonstrated impact is memory corruption and abnormal process termination.
- **Relevance:** libmongocrypt is MongoDB's official client-side and Queryable Encryption library and is therefore part of the required MongoDB driver/library sweep.
- **Freshness:** MongoDB's CNA record was published on 2026-11-12 at 23:53 UTC, inside the scan window.
- **Source:** [CVE Program record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-126792), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-126792)

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible security research. No additional MongoDB finding survived the 24-hour freshness and credibility checks.

**Closing:** Immediate review is recommended for applications using MongoDB C# Driver versions below 3.14.0 because CVE-2026-126982 may permit application-level code execution when its stated preconditions are met. Also identify deployments that bundle libmongocrypt 1.1.0 through 1.21.2.
